scope: SQLean local interfaces, PostgreSQL coverage and client/migration/recovery routing design

local_parser_audit.report_assurance: In-process proof-carrying context-free derivation and exact reconstruction; static validity and PostgreSQL C semantic actions explicitly not checked. JSON is not an independently replayable serialized proof.

read_only_probes.psycopg_percent_template: grammar-rejected; wire proxy avoids application normalization
read_only_probes.complete_current_migration: grammar-accepted; opaque DO bodies separately remain unacceptable
read_only_probes.deliberately_invalid_inner_DO_body: outer grammar-accepted, demonstrating the need for the explicit opaque-production ban

local_parser_audit.own_project_license: No top-level own-project LICENSE/COPYING found; explicit user local authorization permits the requested local engineering. Redistribution/commercial clearance remains unresolved.

approval_basis: Wire inspection of Q and P covers real driver-numbered SQL plus implicit BEGIN/COMMIT, psql, pg_dump and pg_restore paths; execute-site wrappers alone do not.
Exact source equality, pinned executable/profile/commit, bounded subprocess, success-only exact cache and no direct fallback define an enforceable finite admission boundary.
UTF-8 and standard_conforming_strings=on are pinned before forwarding; safe fixed setting templates avoid parameterized set_config changing lexer modes.
Nested production denial addresses opaque SQL bodies and EXECUTE under wrappers such as EXPLAIN. Bind/COPY bytes remain data.
Connection-local immutable portal snapshots, explicit object/frame/memory/deadline limits, reserved cancellation capacity and independent per-client evidence are specified.
Migration rewrite preserves existing records/vectors/journal and independently checks constraints rather than letting a partially installed sibling suppress repair.

client_inventory.retrieval/allow_retrieval/database.py: Repository psycopg connect; 56 explicit execute sites, plus implicit transaction commands. Fixed literal Allow scope setting templates replace dynamic setting-key parameters.
client_inventory.retrieval/tests/test_repository.py: 19 execute sites and direct/raw connection negative controls; all database-facing cases must move to proxy DSNs.
client_inventory.scripts/bootstrap_corpus.py: psql helper, role/database/catalog/bootstrap queries, extension installation, migration script execution, and readiness SQL currently address original socket.
client_inventory.scripts/retrieval_recovery_test.py: 2 direct connects, 7 execute sites, actual pg_dump and pg_restore clients; temporary database name may vary while proxy endpoint stays fixed.
client_inventory.driver_hidden_sql: psycopg implicit BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK and prepared-statement lifecycle; psql/libpq and dump/restore session/catalog SQL.
client_inventory.engine_not_client_queries: Native initdb/bootstrap internals and reviewed extension implementation remain explicitly engine-trusted, not falsely claimed as intercepted frontend SQL.

concrete_implementation_plan: Root owns bounded PostgreSQL protocol proxy and pinned parser runner. Rebuild from a hashed local source snapshot without editing the reference repository; preserve source/binary/toolchain/notice evidence.

Replace migration DO/EXECUTE bodies with explicit statement lists and independently scoped catalog checks. Keep original migration frozen as historical baseline, and test fresh, existing and partial migration repair.

Route private app/admin configuration, bootstrap psql, all Repository connections and dump/restore clients exclusively to the canonical private proxy socket. Disable backend TCP; keep backend socket details only in proxy configuration.
Validate explicit/env DSNs before any connection. Reject service/hostaddr/multihost/direct endpoints; permit only documented recovery database-name variation.
Change scope setters to fixed reviewed literal keys allow.tenant, allow.project, allow.purpose with only values parameterized.

Measure separate admitted-query counter deltas and endpoints for each client path, including driver transaction controls and real backup recovery. Include malformed/fragmented packets, parser absence/tamper and pipelined unsafe setting tests.
implementation_obligations_not_design_bl: Classify all PREPARE forms conservatively, including two-phase transaction controls, so disconnect behavior cannot be confused with a transaction already prepared/committed.
Never retain parser SQL/token reports in logs: bootstrap role SQL may contain a private password. Cache remains bounded memory-only.
Avoid claiming grammar acceptance enforces tenant rights or prevents SQL effects. PostgreSQL execution/RLS and the trusted local application retain their own obligations.
Re-run retrieval, real restore/journal, runtime and HTTP checks after routing; pre-routing success is historical evidence only.
limits: Read-only assessment and parser-only probes; no PostgreSQL SQL execution, SQL mutation, source import, installation or production change performed for this review. Earlier G2/G3 inventory was paused at root request; document-stage formal/production work remains unstarted.
